evidencePolicy.note: Related paths and test declarations establish source leads, not individual action behavior. Promotion to implemented_verified requires exact executable action evidence and platform capture; no historical backend count substitutes.

guidance.use: 48dp minimum Android interaction targets and meaningful semantics.
Contrast and text-resize acceptance guidance; no whole-app conformance claimed.

acceptanceChecklist.title: One obvious next step
acceptanceChecklist.criteria: Clear heading and one visually primary action per state; plain-language labels, secondary detail progressively disclosed. No guilt, nutrition moralizing or required social participation.

acceptanceChecklist.title: Predictable Back and resume
acceptanceChecklist.criteria: Toolbar/system Back/gesture dismiss the top modal, preserve draft and valid selection, and return to authorized source. Dirty exit and external/provider cancellation tested; no duplicate sends.

acceptanceChecklist.title: Reachable touch controls
acceptanceChecklist.criteria: At least 48dp Android interactive targets, non-overlapping hit areas, safe insets and keyboard reachability; separately verify native iOS accessibility sizing.

acceptanceChecklist.title: Readable visual system
acceptanceChecklist.criteria: Normal text contrast at least 4.5:1, large text and relevant control boundaries at least 3:1 against actual backgrounds. Test system text scaling, narrow width, focus and long labels. Token-only checks are not blanket WCAG conformance.

acceptanceChecklist.title: Accessible semantics
acceptanceChecklist.criteria: Meaningful roles, labels, selected/expanded state and traversal order; decorative images excluded, actual food photos labelled; text validation announced and corrected via actual callbacks. TalkBack/VoiceOver checks required.

acceptanceChecklist.title: All non-happy states
acceptanceChecklist.criteria: Loading, empty, offline, denied/expired/recalled, validation, rate-limit and retry outcomes retain eligible input. Busy disables only conflicting actions; local/pending/unknown/acknowledged are distinct.

acceptanceChecklist.title: Exact destructive consent
acceptanceChecklist.criteria: Name exact affected item and consequences; Cancel/Back sends nothing; stale selection/revision invalidates consent; async success requires real current receipt and caller delivery.

acceptanceChecklist.title: No fake navigation or success
acceptanceChecklist.criteria: Every visible production action has typed destination or honest in-place outcome and real handler. No empty callbacks, invented account/publication/payment success, synthetic content masquerading as live data, or GET-as-ACK.

acceptanceChecklist.title: V1 guard at every entry
acceptanceChecklist.criteria: Test button, deep link, restored route, picker mode and direct operation refusal for deferred variants; shared screens are not unrestricted. Member and staff entry are separated.

acceptanceChecklist.title: Evidence before acceptance
acceptanceChecklist.criteria: Attach exact source revision, test/method identity, platform/device/configuration and uncropped captured UI. Review loading/error/offline/empty, rotation/process return and accessibility; no build count used as whole-screen proof.
